name: Scrape, imprint and Tzanck smears
use: Vesiculobullous lesions, herpes, pemphigus, skin tumours (BCC/SCC), intraoperative touch preps.
not_use: Definitive diagnosis of blistering disease (requires biopsy + DIF).

adequacy.title: Adequacy
items: Scrape base of fresh intact vesicle; air-dried (Giemsa) and alcohol-fixed slides.

diagnoses.name: Herpes simplex/zoster cytopathic effect
diagnoses.final: Tzanck positive: multinucleated giant cells with moulding, margination and inclusions.

diagnoses.name: Molluscum bodies
diagnoses.comment: Large eosinophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions (Henderson–Patterson bodies) in squames; diagnostic in the right clinical setting.

diagnoses.name: Leishmania (LD bodies)
diagnoses.comment: Amastigotes (2–4 µm, nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast) in macrophages on Giemsa; confirm by culture/PCR.

categories.name: Malignant
criteria: BCC: basaloid clusters with palisading; SCC; melanoma.

diagnoses.name: Basal cell carcinoma
diagnoses.final: Malignant cells consistent with basal cell carcinoma.

diagnoses.name: Squamous cell carcinoma
diagnoses.comment: Keratinised atypical squames with tadpole/fibre shapes and necrosis; excision biopsy needed to confirm invasion.

extra.title: Status
items: Consensus/descriptive – no official international reporting system.

references: Cibas ES, Ducatman BS. Cytology: Diagnostic Principles and Clinical Correlates. 5th ed. Elsevier, 2020.
Koss LG, Melamed MR. Koss' Diagnostic Cytology and Its Histopathologic Bases. 5th ed. Lippincott Williams & Wilkins, 2006.
Field AS, Zarka MA (eds). Practical Cytopathology: A Diagnostic Approach to Fine Needle Aspiration Biopsy. Elsevier, 2017.
